transformations: Removed seed-only contract/body string constants and replaced them with an executable Verus target harness.

Adapted the implicit mutable slice receiver to an explicit `slice: &mut [T]` argument while preserving the Rust 1.96 checked_sub early-None, split_at_mut(index), and unsafe suffix cast control-flow shape.
Added the source-required ptr_cast_array feature gate for the final unsafe pointer conversion.
Isolated only `unsafe { &mut *(last.as_mut_ptr().cast_array()) }` as the target-local source-backed raw-pointer/mutable-array-reference boundary.
